{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the required evidence
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
